based_in.value: Seoul, South Korea, with a US headquarters in San Francisco

growth_signal.value: 14 million registered users across 220+ countries; active U.S. paid subscriptions grew 13.5 times in the past year, with over 60% of paid subscribers based in the U.S.

raised.value: $36.1M Series C, after a $20-29M (27B KRW) Series B in October 2024

entry.idea: Liner is an AI search and research assistant that answers questions with citations you can check, instead of just giving an unsourced answer like a typical chatbot.
entry.lesson: Once you have real usage data on which AI model handles which type of question best, you can resell that matching intelligence as its own product.
entry.name: Liner

growth.reason: It has 14 million users worldwide and U.S. paid subscriptions grew 13.5 times in a single year, clear and fast growth.

market.reason: AI-assisted search and research tools compete directly with the biggest search and productivity markets in the world.

tech.reason: It built its own model-evaluation and routing system based on real usage data across its own products, solid applied AI engineering rather than a new foundation model.

Korean AI Startup Liner Takes on Google in U.S. Search Market
S.Korea's Liner, the world's No. 4 generative AI web product - KED Global
Liner raises $36.1M to take its evidence-first AI search to enterprise customers

entry.twist: It automatically routes easy questions to cheap, lightweight AI models and hard questions to expensive top-tier models, cutting the cost of running AI answers by more than half without losing answer quality.
entry.who_pays: Individual professionals, students and researchers subscribe for Liner's search, research and writing tools, and businesses pay to use its model-routing API to cut their own AI costs.
entry.why_now: People are tired of AI answers they cannot verify, and as AI use scales up, the cost of always using the most expensive model for every question has become a real problem for businesses.

mentions.snippet: AI agent startup; launched an API that picks the right language model per question to cut token costs by half.
